summary.text: Pat Heinert is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives representing District 32 (Bismarck), serving since 2017. His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Education, which he chairs, and Energy and Natural Resources.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Heinert is retired and is a past Burleigh County Sheriff.

He holds a BS and an MM in management from the University of Mary, and his biography lists him as a member of the St. Mary's Central High School Hall of Fame and the University of Mary Hall of Fame, and of the Knights of Columbus.
In the interim he chairs the Kratom Working Group and serves on the Emergency Response Services Committee and the Energy Development and Transmission Committee.
His biography lists him as married to Lynn, with two children.
